query: Build the approved plan for the Northstar product's workspace record screen in both web and native clients. The plan names the approved contextual drawer default, the existing drawer component, and a narrow-layout variant supported by that component. A linked theme file was changed in this same diff and lowers primary-action contrast. The plan also includes a backend status rename visible to users and an internal index optimization.
expected_behavior: Resolves the app's design source and reads only applicable rules and cited sources before implementing affected UI
Keeps both clients on the approved drawer default and uses only the named narrow-layout variant
Checks the changed theme treatment against approved intent instead of treating its current values as self-approval
Checks the backend status rename because it changes visible vocabulary, while skipping the internal index optimization
Uses native evidence for the native client and does not require CSS tooling or browser-only proof there
Does not require a new approval for routine pattern reuse; reports any missing visual proof as unverified
